parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of instances to return per page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: A pagination token returned from a previous call. Use it to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation get a list of available region IDs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb list-supabase-projects --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 20 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --search-field ProjectId --search-value gp-bp000000000000000 --sort-field UpdatedDate --sort-order desc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb ListSupabaseProjects --region cn-hangzhou --SearchField ProjectId --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --PageSize 30 --PageNumber 1 --MaxResults 20 --SearchValue 'gp-bp000000000000000' --SortOrder desc --SortField UpdatedDate --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
